prayerExcerpt.en-US: He was a good man, full of the Holy Spirit and of faith.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Era um homem bom, cheio do Espírito Santo e de fé.

meta.face: A greying man around 55, grey-streaked brown hair, a long grey-streaked beard reaching the chest, warm encouraging expression.
meta.basis: Greying man with a long beard (Painter's Manual).

sources.title: Dionysius of Fourna, The Painter's Manual (Hermeneia), c. 1730 — Didron's 1845 French edition
